description: WOTS w=16 over SHA-256. ADRS = u32be(type)|u32be(leaf)|u32be(chain)|u32be(step)|16 zero bytes. F(pubSeed, ADRS, x) = SHA-256(pubSeed||ADRS||x). sk_i = SHA-256(skSeed||ADRS(3,leaf,i,0)). pk_i = sk_i walked 15 steps (positions 0..14). sigma_i = sk_i walked d_i steps. publicKey = pubSeed||pk_0..pk_66; publicKeyHash = SHA-256(publicKey). leaf = 0 for vault keys.
